verdict.rationale: cubic documents an org analytics dashboard. Its AI review tab shows what cubic's reviews find, what the team fixes, and whether reviews help ship better code. An Analytics API adds PR-level counts of issues flagged and fixed, and a delivery tab tracks merge speed. Findings and fix-based acceptance are covered, but review coverage is never explicitly mentioned. Missing for 10: an explicit review-coverage metric (share of PRs or repos reviewed), an explicitly named acceptance-rate metric (only fixed counts are documented), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboards.
